Penta is a leading corporate affairs advisory firm that helps organizations predict what matters and shape outcomes. By combining proprietary intelligence, stakeholder insights, and strategic counsel, we help CEOs and leadership teams navigate the increasingly complex intersection of business, policy, culture, and reputation. Our clients turn to us when the stakes are high, the signals are difficult to interpret, and the consequences of getting it wrong are significant. We are building a new model for corporate affairs advisory and are seeking leaders who want to help define the future of the industry.

Penta’s global team brings decades of experience in business, government, communications, research, data science, and media. Our clients include many of the world's most influential organizations across technology, financial services, energy, healthcare, and other sectors, including over 25% of the Fortune 100. Penta has offices in New York, Washington DC, San Francisco, London, Brussels, Dublin, and Singapore.

Role Summary:

As a Monitoring & Insights Intern, you will support Penta’s Intelligence division across both our proprietary insights and real-time monitoring services, helping global clients understand stakeholder sentiment, media coverage, and emerging risks. You will work with large volumes of news, media, and proprietary data to produce both real-time outputs and longer-form analysis, contributing to alerts, briefings, and client and industry facing reports on reputation, topic trends, and stakeholder views. Your work will involve tracking developments as they unfold, identifying key drivers behind trends, creating visualizations, and translating data into clear, actionable insights.

Working alongside our analysts, you will use industry-leading media aggregation and analytics tools to monitor coverage in real time while building structured analyses. You will support the delivery of alerts, briefings, and reports, helping clients respond to media developments as they happen while also contributing to deeper insights that inform planning, strategy, and decision-making. This role is ideal for an ambitious and analytically minded early-career professional interested in media analysis, business intelligence, and stakeholder insights, and offers training, mentorship, and professional development within a fast-paced and dynamic team.

This role is expected to:

- Monitor news and events across outlets and platforms, including print, digital, television, radio, and social media

- Collaborate with a team of analysts to alert the news to clients in a timely and effective manner

- Collect and prepare data to support media analysis and scheduled report deliveries

- Assist with long-term research projects

- Create pivot tables from Excel report data

- Update report graphics and charts for review

- Write descriptive text to tell the stories behind data

- Validate and interpret automated scoring from Penta’s proprietary platform on reputation risk, and stakeholder views

The ideal candidate will have:

- A bachelor's degree in any discipline, where a focus on communications, journalism, economics, history, or another social science is preferred

- Experience writing analytical reports & creating engaging presentations using Microsoft office, or Google Suite products

- A solid understanding of leveraging Excel for exploratory data analysis & visualization purposes

- A strong interest in media, the 24/7 news cycle, and the intersection of culture, business, and politics

- Excellent communication, organizational, and writing skills

- Intellectual curiosity and a desire to understand the deeper meaning behind content or data

- Meticulous attention to detail and a strong ownership mentality

- Coachability and possess a learning & growth oriented mindset

- The ability to prioritize multiple, competing priorities

- Experience working in teams with a collaborative mindset

Compensation:

This is a non-exempt position eligible for overtime. The hourly pay for this internship will be $20 per hour. Any pre-approved hours worked over 40 hours per week will be paid at time and a half.

Benefits:

- Dynamic and supportive environment for learning and growth

- Access to ongoing training to help develop a strong understanding of the technology and methods used to monitor the news

- Mentoring opportunities and support in the development of long-term career goals

Location, Work Hours, and Remote Schedule:

For this position, we are only considering applicants located in the United States who are able to work remotely 35-40 hours per week during a morning shift (6 am - 2 pm ET). Occasional evening shifts (5pm - 8 pm ET) on both Saturday and Sunday will be required on a rotational basis every six weeks throughout the internship. The internship’s duration will be 3 months with the possibility of extension, and have anticipated start date of mid-September through mid-December 2026.

Machine Learning Engineering Intern

> Bask Health · United States (Remote) · Full-time · Posted 2026-11-12

Workplace: remote

Department: AI & Machine Learning

Description

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineering Intern to join Bask Health's engineering team and gain practical experience developing machine learning models, working with real application data, and supporting production ML systems.

Bask Health provides the technology behind direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses, connecting merchant storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce capabilities. As we expand our machine learning capabilities, we're looking for motivated individuals who want to learn how intelligent systems are developed, evaluated, and integrated into real software products.

You'll work alongside experienced machine learning engineers, applied AI engineers, software engineers, and product teams to contribute to machine learning projects across the platform.

This internship is designed to provide hands-on engineering experience. Rather than focusing exclusively on theoretical research, you'll learn how machine learning models are developed, tested, improved, and prepared for use in production applications.

Your work may include preparing datasets, exploring model architectures, implementing training scripts, evaluating model performance, and helping integrate machine learning capabilities into existing software systems.

You'll gain exposure to practical machine learning workflows, including feature engineering, experiment tracking, model validation, performance monitoring, and reproducible development practices.

You'll also learn how engineering teams evaluate whether a machine learning solution is appropriate for a product problem, compare model approaches, and balance accuracy with reliability, latency, and operational cost.

You'll receive guidance from experienced engineers while contributing to appropriately scoped projects. As you develop your skills, you'll have opportunities to take greater ownership of technical tasks and communicate your findings to the team.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll learn how privacy, secure data handling, appropriate permissions, and human oversight affect machine learning development. You'll work with approved datasets and established safeguards, and your work will not involve independently making clinical decisions or determining patient treatment.

We welcome candidates who have developed machine learning skills through university coursework, independent projects, research, internships, hackathons, or self-directed learning. Previous professional machine learning engineering experience is not required.

We're looking for someone who enjoys programming, is curious about how machine learning systems work, and wants to develop the practical engineering skills needed to build reliable intelligent software.

What You'll Do

-   Assist with developing machine learning models and supporting engineering systems across Bask Health.
-   Work with experienced engineers to understand practical machine learning development workflows.
-   Prepare, clean, and transform approved datasets for model training and evaluation.
-   Write Python scripts for data processing, experimentation, and model development.
-   Assist with implementing supervised learning models and baseline algorithms.
-   Explore classification, regression, ranking, and other machine learning approaches.
-   Help develop feature engineering pipelines for machine learning applications.
-   Assist with training, validating, and evaluating machine learning models.
-   Compare model performance using appropriate evaluation metrics.
-   Help investigate model errors and unexpected predictions.
-   Support the development of reproducible machine learning experiments.
-   Document model configurations, datasets, assumptions, and evaluation results.
-   Assist with building automated data validation and model testing workflows.
-   Learn how machine learning models are integrated into backend services and APIs.
-   Contribute to small machine learning application features under engineering guidance.
-   Assist with model inference testing and performance measurement.
-   Help monitor model behavior and investigate reliability issues.
-   Work with engineers to understand model deployment and production monitoring processes.
-   Assist with developing scripts and utilities that support ML engineering workflows.
-   Explore techniques for improving model accuracy, efficiency, and generalization.
-   Help identify data quality issues that affect model performance.
-   Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback from experienced engineers.
-   Learn and follow Bask Health's software engineering and machine learning development standards.
-   Use version control and collaborative development tools to manage assigned work.
-   Collaborate with software engineers and product teams to understand machine learning use cases.
-   Present experiment results, technical findings, and project progress to team members.
-   Learn about responsible machine learning practices and secure data handling.
-   Complete assigned machine learning engineering projects with mentorship, documentation, and appropriate testing.

Requirements

-   Currently pursuing, recently completed, or independently developing skills equivalent to a degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field.
-   Foundational programming skills in Python or a comparable language.
-   Basic understanding of machine learning concepts and common algorithms.
-   Familiarity with supervised learning, including classification or regression.
-   Understanding of basic programming principles and data structures.
-   Familiarity with data processing and manipulation techniques.
-   Basic knowledge of Python libraries such as NumPy, pandas, or comparable tools.
-   Understanding of model training, validation, and testing concepts.
-   Familiarity with common machine learning evaluation metrics.
-   Basic understanding of probability, statistics, or linear algebra.
-   Ability to write and debug Python scripts.
-   Familiarity with structured datasets and tabular data.
-   Basic understanding of SQL or willingness to learn database querying.
-   Familiarity with Git or willingness to learn version control workflows.
-   Ability to read technical documentation and follow implementation instructions.
-   Interest in building practical machine learning applications.
-   Willingness to learn machine learning frameworks and development tools.
-   Understanding of basic software testing and debugging practices.
-   Ability to explain technical concepts and experiment results clearly.
-   Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
-   Attention to detail when working with datasets and model outputs.
-   Ability to collaborate with engineers and other technical team members.
-   Openness to feedback and mentorship.
-   Ability to manage assigned tasks and communicate progress.
-   Strong curiosity about production machine learning systems and their real-world applications.

Nice to Have

-   Academic, personal, research, or internship projects involving machine learning.
-   Experience using scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or comparable ML frameworks.
-   Familiarity with model training and hyperparameter tuning.
-   Experience developing classification, regression, or recommendation models.
-   Basic understanding of neural networks and deep learning.
-   Familiarity with natural language processing or text classification.
-   Experience working with Jupyter notebooks or comparable development environments.
-   Familiarity with data visualization libraries.
-   Experience using SQL to query and analyze datasets.
-   Exposure to feature engineering and data preprocessing techniques.
-   Familiarity with model evaluation metrics such as precision, recall, F1 score, or ROC-AUC.
-   Experience using GitHub to share programming or machine learning projects.
-   Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure.
-   Familiarity with MLflow, Weights & Biases, or comparable experiment tracking tools.
-   Basic understanding of model deployment and inference APIs.
-   Experience participating in machine learning competitions, hackathons, or research projects.
-   Familiarity with recommendation systems, ranking models, or predictive analytics.
-   Interest in healthcare technology, telehealth, or e-commerce applications.
-   Basic awareness of data privacy, model bias, and responsible machine learning.
-   Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code.

Immuta is the Data Authorization Company, helping the world’s largest organizations control who, and what, can access their data.

The way enterprises access data is fundamentally changing. Organizations are racing to put data to work across analytics and AI, while AI copilots and agents are emerging as an entirely new class of data consumer. Traditional approaches built around tickets, static permissions, and manual approvals were not designed for this speed, scale, or complexity.

Immuta provides the authorization layer for modern data and AI. Our platform enables organizations to provision governed access to data by policy, by request, and dynamically for AI agents, so people and AI can access the data they need while enterprises maintain security, compliance, and control.

For Chief Data Officers, that means making enterprise data dramatically easier to access and use without giving up governance. For AI leaders, it means giving AI agents secure, governed access to enterprise data so they can move from experimentation into production.
